title: The Diamond NPU  The Null Axis Is the Klein Face of the Diamond Tip, the Point Is the Inversion of a Prism
thesis: CPU processes serial (hand-wound clock). GPU processes parallel (Big Ben). NPU processes neural (crystal clock). A diamond computer processes through the LATTICE ITSELF  the 109.5° bonds ARE the neural network. And the contact point of the spinning top IS the Klein face: because a prism takes a point and spreads it to spectrum, so the INVERSE prism takes spectrum and collapses it back to a point. The diamond tip IS both  the same object does prism AND inverse-prism. The point where it inverts is the null axis. The null axis IS the Klein face.

cpu.processing: Serial  one instruction at a time, very fast
cpu.clock_analog: HAND-WOUND  Kevin turns the crank, one operation per cycle
cpu.geometry: Linear. Instructions flow in a LINE. Pipeline. One dimension.
cpu.material: Silicon (Si, Z=14, same tetrahedral bonds as carbon, 111.5° in crystal)
cpu.limitation: ~5 GHz wall. Can't spin faster. Heat death.

gpu.processing: Parallel  thousands of simple cores, same instruction
gpu.clock_analog: BIG BEN  one clock face, many hands, all synchronized
gpu.geometry: Grid. Cores arranged in 2D array. SIMD (Single Instruction Multiple Data). Two dimensions.
gpu.material: Silicon, but MANY transistors (billions) running the same clock
gpu.limitation: Memory bandwidth wall. Can compute fast but can't feed data fast enough.

npu.processing: Neural  matrix multiplication, activation, inference in hardware
npu.clock_analog: CRYSTAL CLOCK  the lattice vibrates at its own frequency, no external sync
npu.geometry: Tensor. Operations flow through a 3D+ lattice of multiply-accumulate units. N dimensions.

why_diamond.thermal: Diamond thermal conductivity: 2,200 W/(m·K). Silicon: 150 W/(m·K). Diamond dissipates heat 14.7× better. The compute limit IS the heat limit. Diamond pushes it 14.7× further.
why_diamond.bandgap: Diamond: 5.47 eV. Silicon: 1.12 eV. Wider bandgap = higher voltage = more power per switch = fewer switches needed. Each diamond transistor does ~5× the work of a silicon one.
why_diamond.speed: Electron mobility in diamond: 4,500 cm²/(V·s). Hole mobility: 3,800. Both exceed silicon. Electrons move FASTER in diamond.
why_diamond.temperature: Diamond operates at 700°C+. Silicon dies at 150°C. A diamond chip works INSIDE a running engine. Inside a star. Inside a reactor.
why_diamond.radiation: Diamond is radiation-hard. The 109.5° bonds are so strong that radiation can't displace atoms. A diamond computer survives space, nuclear environments, particle accelerators.

the_nv_center.what: Nitrogen-Vacancy center. A DEFECT in the diamond lattice where: one carbon atom is replaced by nitrogen (N), AND the adjacent site is VACANT (V, empty, missing).
the_nv_center.the_null: The vacancy IS a null point. An atom that SHOULD be there but ISN'T. The lattice expects carbon at that site. Instead: nothing. A hole in the crystal. A 0D point of absence.
the_nv_center.quantum_property: The NV center has an electron spin that can be: |0? (ground state) or |1? (excited state) or SUPERPOSITION of both. It's a natural qubit. A quantum bit made from NOTHING  from the absence of an atom.
the_nv_center.manipulation: You control the NV center with GREEN LIGHT. A green laser (532nm) excites the electron. Microwave pulses flip the spin. You READ the state by measuring fluorescence. The NV center emits RED light (637nm) when it relaxes. Green in ? red out. Chlorophyll in REVERSE.
the_nv_center.coherence: NV centers maintain quantum coherence at ROOM TEMPERATURE. Most qubits need millikelvin cooling. Diamond qubits work on your desk. Because the lattice is so rigid (109.5° bonds, hardness 10) that thermal vibrations can't disturb the quantum state.
the_nv_center.the_klein_face: The NV center IS the Klein face of the diamond. Where something IS (nitrogen, a different atom) and ISN'T (vacancy, no atom) at the same point. Inside (the lattice) meets outside (the void) at the NV center. The qubit exists at the boundary between presence and absence.

diamond_npu_concept.lattice_as_network: In a diamond NPU, the crystal lattice IS the neural network. Each carbon-carbon bond is a connection. Each atom is a node. The 109.5° angle is the activation function  it determines how signal propagates through the network.
diamond_npu_concept.nv_centers_as_neurons: NV centers (the null points) are the computation sites. Each NV center is a neuron  it receives input (green light), processes (quantum spin manipulation), and outputs (red fluorescence).
diamond_npu_concept.the_crystal_IS_the_computer: No transistors. No wires. No lithography. The CRYSTAL ITSELF computes. The geometry IS the circuit. The bonds ARE the connections. The nulls ARE the processors.
diamond_npu_concept.green_in_red_out: Input: 532nm green laser. Process: quantum spin at NV center. Output: 637nm red fluorescence. GREEN ? process ? RED. The chlorophyll of computation. The engine absorbs green and emits red. The NPU is a synthetic leaf.

prism.what: White light enters as a single beam (point). The prism separates wavelengths by refraction (different geodesics). Spectrum exits  red one way, violet another, green in between.

inverse_prism.what: A second prism, inverted, takes the separated spectrum and RECONVERGES it back to white. Many wavelengths ? one beam. Spectrum ? point.

the_diamond_tip.what: The contact point of the spinning top on the diamond plate. ALL the colors at the equator (the full spectrum, the iridescence) converge DOWN to the single point at the tip.
the_diamond_tip.IS_the_inverse_prism: The spinning top's equator is the SPECTRUM (spread, multi-color, nD). The tip is the POINT (converged, null, 0D). The shape of the top IS the inverse prism. Spectrum at the equator ? point at the tip.
the_diamond_tip.AND_the_prism: Looking the OTHER direction  from tip UP to equator  the point SPREADS into spectrum. The same top is BOTH prism and inverse-prism depending on which direction you look.
the_diamond_tip.the_klein_fold: Prism (point?spectrum) and inverse-prism (spectrum?point) are the SAME object viewed from opposite directions. But on a Klein surface, opposite directions ARE the same direction. The tip IS the fold. The point where prism inverts to inverse-prism IS the Klein face.

the_proof.from_above: Looking down the null axis: spectrum (all colors, iridescence, the equator). You see OUTSIDE  the public face, the output, the surface.
the_proof.from_below: Looking up the null axis: point (0D, green dot, the contact). You see INSIDE  the private kernel, the input, the null.
the_proof.same_axis: Above and below are opposite directions on the SAME axis. On a Klein bottle, opposite directions connect  they're the same surface. The null axis IS the Klein face because looking one way shows spectrum (outside) and looking the other way shows point (inside), and they're the SAME THING.
the_proof.the_inversion_point: The diamond tip is WHERE the inversion happens. Where spectrum becomes point. Where outside becomes inside. Where prism becomes inverse-prism. The tip IS the Klein face. The face IS the tip.

nv_center_connection.vacancy: The NV center's vacancy = the 0D point = the tip of the top = the Klein face
nv_center_connection.nitrogen: The NV center's nitrogen = the foreign atom = the visitor = the violet photon testing the crystal
nv_center_connection.together: At the Klein face: something IS (nitrogen) and ISN'T (vacancy). The prism IS (point?spectrum) and ISN'T (spectrum?point). The top IS spinning (alive) and ISN'T (touching one null point). All inversions happen at the same 0D face.

cpu_silicon_line.diamond_analog: A single carbon-carbon bond. One connection. One pathway.

gpu_silicon_grid.diamond_analog: A graphene sheet. Hexagonal. 2D layer of carbon. Flat. Fast but thin.
gpu_silicon_grid.time: Institutional time. One clock, many followers.

npu_diamond_lattice.diamond_analog: The full diamond crystal. 3D tetrahedral network. NV centers at the nulls.
npu_diamond_lattice.time: Sovereign time. The lattice vibrates at its own frequency. Hyperlocal IS universal.
npu_diamond_lattice.green_in_red_out: 532nm ? NV center ? 637nm. Green engine processes, red structure outputs.

convergence.current_state: We use GPU (RTX 4070 on eastGate, silicon, 2D grid) to run 859 WGSL shaders.
convergence.the_path: Silicon GPU ? diamond NPU. Same tetrahedral bonds (Si 111.5° vs C 109.5°). Same crystal family (cubic). The GPU shaders we write today ARE the neural pathways of tomorrow's diamond NPU.
convergence.the_wobble_tells_us: The 5° gap between silicon (111.5°) and diamond (109.5°) is the same 5° as the top's precession cone. The wobble IS the evolution from silicon to diamond. Each precession cycle brings us 0.14159° closer.
convergence.barraCuda: Our GPU compute crate. Written in Rust. Compiles WGSL shaders. TODAY it targets silicon via wgpu/Vulkan. TOMORROW the same shader graph targets diamond NV centers. The abstraction layer (wgpu) is the bridge. The bridge is already built.
